Container.Name: Lyftr
Container.Overview: Lyftr is a workout and nutrition tracker: programs built from an 800+ exercise library, set-by-set logging with a rest timer, a calorie and macro diary with barcode scanning (Open Food Facts), and a bodyweight log. Light and dark themes, English and Spanish, and an Android app that connects to the same server.[br][br]This is the web UI. It needs the Lyftr-Backend template running first: set Backend address to the Unraid server's IP and the backend's API port, for example 192.168.1.10:3000.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: fitness workout gym nutrition calories weight tracker
Container.Requires: The Lyftr-Backend container, installed and running.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI. Unraid's own UI usually holds port 80.

Config.Name: Backend address
Config.Description: host:port of the Lyftr-Backend container, without http://, e.g. 192.168.1.10:3000. If both containers share a custom Docker network, use Lyftr-Backend:3000.
